sentences.en: Juha found a mirror on the road.
He had never seen a mirror.
He picked it up and looked in it.

sentences.ar: הוא ראה שם פנים של איש.
sentences.en: He saw there a man’s face.
He said: what an ugly man.
He threw it back on the ground.
He walked a little and stopped.

sentences.ar: הוא חשב: אולי לא יפה לזרוק.
sentences.en: He thought: perhaps it is not nice to throw.
He came back and picked it up again.
He looked in it one more time.

sentences.ar: הוא אמר: הוא זרק אותה בעצמו.
sentences.en: He said: he threw it away himself.

sentences.ar: הוא אמר: הוא ידע איך הוא נראה.
sentences.en: He said: he knew how he looks.
He put it at the side of the road.

sentences.ar: הוא אמר: שלא יראה אותה שוב.
sentences.en: He said: so that he will not see it again.
